title: The Murder of Ish-bosheth
description: Rekab and Baana, the sons of Rimmon from Beeroth, crept into Ish-bosheth's house while he was resting at midday and killed him. They cut off his head and brought it to David in Hebron, hoping for a reward because they had taken the life of Saul's son. David became angry and reminded them how he had executed the messenger who reported Saul's death. He sentenced the two men to death for killing an innocent man in his own bed, ordered their execution, and hung their bodies by the pool in Hebron. Ish-bosheth's head was buried with honor in Abner's tomb.
